changed.title: Some AND/OR/NOT circuit of fan-in two with at most 5 gates represents one of two named 5 by 5 graphs (masks 16235582, 16236078) on the one-a-side promise
changed.statement:
∃ M ∈ ([16235582, 16236078] : List ℕ), ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 5 ∧
  PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun u v : Fin 5 => M.testBit (5 * u.val + v.val)) C
changed.unlocks: whether a NOT gate can save more than 2n - 5 gates on the one-a-side promise at side 5, on the two graphs the read-once count leaves open; a met step breaks the 2n - 5 pair there.
changed.context: No witness is known to us; this is a search; two NOT gates or an input read twice are possible here. Each graph needs at least 11 gates without NOT gates (checked floors: the 'at most 10 AND/OR' rows read refuted). The other twenty masks of the first break step are covered by a separate 'none exists' form. No sorry, no new axiom. Own namespace for every declaration.

changed.title: Find a binary De Morgan formula below the parity-lane leaf bound for full cyclic window tables
changed.statement:
∃ d extra a q : ℕ,
  let k := d + 1
  let w := k + extra
  let m := a + 1
  let n := m * k + q * (k + 1)
  let hn : 0 < n := by dsimp [n, m, k]; positivity
  let stride := 2 ^ (w + 1)
  let I := n * stride
  ∃ F : PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.DMFormula I,
    (∀ table : Fin n → (Fin (w + 1) → Bool) → Bool,
      let inputs := fun addr : Fin I =>
        table ⟨(addr.val / stride) % n, Nat.mod_lt _ hn⟩ (fun bit => addr.val.testBit bit.val)
      F.eval inputs = true ↔ ∃ word : Fin n → Bool, ∀ i : Fin n,
        table i (fun k => word ⟨(i.val + k.val) % n, Nat.mod_lt _ hn⟩) = true) ∧
    F.leaves < 2 ^ d * m ^ 2
changed.unlocks: tests the proposed leaf floor for full cyclic window table decision formulas
changed.context: Exhibit the four integer parameters and the formula tree. Count all signed literal occurrences, including repeated uses. Verify its output on every physical table against the existential cyclic-word test. A promising restriction must survive all assignments to the unused rows and padding entries.

Verify its output on every physical table against the existential cyclic-word test. A promising restriction must survive all assignments to the unused rows and padding entries.

changed.title: Find a nineteen-leaf binary De Morgan formula for three binary relations with an indexed closed walk
changed.statement:
let addr := fun (r a b : ℕ) => (Fin.ofNat 12 (4 * r + a + 2 * b))
let accepts := fun (x : Fin 12 → Bool) =>
    ∃ s t u : Fin 2, x (addr 0 s.val t.val) = true ∧
      x (addr 1 t.val u.val) = true ∧ x (addr 2 u.val s.val) = true
∃ F : PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.DMFormula 12, F.leaves ≤ 19 ∧
    ∀ x, F.eval x = true ↔ accepts x
changed.unlocks: tests whether the twenty-leaf three-relation formula can be shortened
changed.context: The explicit twenty-leaf formula groups the eight candidate cyclic words by their first two states. Each of the four groups uses one literal for the first relation and two pairs for the remaining transitions. Seek an equivalent tree with at most nineteen leaves. Test the same twelve raw bits, including all loops, both edge orientations and negated literals.

changed.title: Majority of 7 bits (at least 4 on): at most 21 AND, OR, NOT gates, none dead, a NOT on a gate
changed.statement: ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack 7 C ∧ C.size ≤ 21 ∧ (∀ x : Fin 7 → Bool, C.eval (List.ofFn x) = decide (4 ≤ (List.ofFn x).count true)) ∧ (∀ j < C.size, C.output = 7 + j ∨ ∃ i < C.size, j < i ∧ 7 + j ∈ (C.gates.getD i ⟨PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and, []⟩).inputs) ∧ (∀ g ∈ C.gates, g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → 7 ≤ g.inputs.headD 0 → (C.gates.getD (g.inputs.headD 0 - 7) ⟨PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and, []⟩).op ≠ PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not) ∧ (∃ g ∈ C.gates, g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not ∧ 7 ≤ g.inputs.headD 0)
changed.unlocks: whether a NOT gate can be at work at the best known size for this function
changed.context: Answer with a circuit: a gate list (AND, OR or NOT, at most two earlier wires each; wires 0 to 6 the inputs, gate j writes wire 7+j) and the output wire, judged on every input. 21 is the size of the best AND/OR circuit the checker has accepted, so a yes is a circuit with a NOT at work that ties it. A circuit where the NOT and the gate reading it can be deleted and the rest is still right satisfies this row and shows nothing; say whether yours survives that deletion. So does a NOT-free circuit three gates smaller with one gate rewritten through NOTs; say if yours is one.
changed.sketch: A circuit three gates below our NOT-free bar also answers this; a calibration of our constructions, no claim attached either way. Answer with a circuit: a gate list (AND, OR or NOT, at most two earlier wires each; wires 0 to 6 the inputs, gate j writes wire 7+j) and the output wire, judged on every input. 21 is the size of the best AND/OR circuit the checker has accepted. A NOT-free circuit of 18 gates with its last gate rewritten through NOTs meets every clause, and so does a circuit whose NOT can be deleted; say which kind yours is.

changed.title: One-a-side promise: the 4 by 5 bipartite graph with mask 34940 has a fan-in-two AND/OR circuit of at most 8 gates
changed.statement: PEqualNP.Represents.RepSizeAtMost (fun (u : Fin 4) (v : Fin 5) => (34940 : ℕ).testBit (5 * u.val + v.val)) 8
changed.unlocks: the AND/OR cost of 4 by 5 graphs off the square, where the checked twin merge sends square graphs, for the silent-line work
changed.sketch: A search unit. We hold a circuit of 9 AND/OR gates (three plain forms, full lines taken out and equal gates merged); at this size those forms are weak; we hold none of 8; this is a search. Our count of unread rows and columns gives a floor of 8 (on paper), a gap of 1. Answer with a gate list (AND or OR, each reading at most two wires; wires 0 to 3 left, 4 to 8 right, gate j writes wire 9 + j, each gate reading only earlier wires) and its output wire, judged on all 20 inputs with one vertex on each side.

changed.statement: PEqualNP.Represents.RepSizeAtMost (fun (u : Fin 4) (v : Fin 6) => (322998 : ℕ).testBit (6 * u.val + v.val)) 9

changed.title: The two-lit function of the graph H on 6 points with mask 118589 on shared wires has an AND/OR/NOT circuit of fan-in two with at most 8 gates
changed.statement: ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 8 ∧ ∀ i j : Fin 6, C.eval (List.ofFn fun k : Fin 6 => decide (k = i ∨ k = j)) = (118589 : ℕ).testBit (6 * min i.val j.val + max i.val j.val)
changed.unlocks: the exact size of the two-lit-points function of this graph on six shared wires; the family shows where a NOT gate pays with no equal lines
changed.sketch: We hold a circuit of 9 gates, a weak hand form (best over a few point orders and the complement plus a NOT, equal gates merged): NOT(1), AND(0,6), NOT(5), AND(2,8), OR(3,4), OR(5,10), AND(1,11), OR(7,9), OR(12,13) (inputs 0-5 are the points, gate k is wire 6 + k, output last). We hold no circuit of 8 gates; this is a search. No complete search of ours has run at six points.
